verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents keyboard shortcuts or a command palette for Outlook; the first-party docs cover only the Microsoft Graph mail API. Community reports on speed are mixed: the web app is said to load in under a second and Outlook for Mac feels native, while new Outlook on Windows is described as slow and unresponsive. Speed alone does not deliver a keyboard-driven workflow, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can do everything from the keyboard — comprehensive shortcuts and a command palette — in an interface fast enough to never make me wait
